question: Name the Sarangi Player who won Padma Shri Award in 2014?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ustad Moinuddin Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Moinuddin Khan**

 
 
• Ustad Moinuddin Khan was a renowned Indian classical musician, primarily known for his mastery of the sarangi.
 
• He belonged to the prestigious Jaipur gharana of Hindustani classical music.
 
• His music was characterized by its deep emotional depth, intricate improvisations, and soulful expressions.
 
• Ustad Moinuddin Khan was highly respected for his contributions to the preservation and propagation of the sarangi tradition.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asad Ali Khan**

 
 
• Asad Ali Khan was a legendary Indian classical musician, a sarangi maestro from the Rampur-Sahaswan gharana.
 
• He was renowned for his virtuosity, innovative techniques, and soulful renditions.
 
• His music was characterized by its unique blend of traditional and contemporary elements, captivating audiences worldwide.
 
• Asad Ali Khan was a highly influential figure in the world of Indian classical music, inspiring generations of musicians.
 
 
 
• **Ustad Sultan Khan**
 
 
• Ustad Sultan Khan was a celebrated Indian classical musician, a sarangi maestro known for his exceptional technical prowess and soulful expressions.
 
• He belonged to the Rampur-Sahaswan gharana, a tradition renowned for its rich musical heritage.
 
• His music was characterized by its intricate improvisations, emotional depth, and unique rhythmic patterns.
 
• Ustad Sultan Khan was highly respected for his contributions to the sarangi tradition and his dedication to preserving its rich legacy.
 
 
 
• **Sajjad Hussain**

• His music was characterized by its intricate improvisations, emotional depth, and unique rhythmic patterns.
